name: dimi
description: Dimi's engineering toolkit for Claude Code. A reviewer-grade development loop (plan from a ticket, state-complete UI, pre-commit self-review, ship, address review, compound learnings into rules) with hooks and agents, plus forward-deployed engineering for LLM agents (harness reference, production-readiness review, MCP hardening, client profiles, fact refresh).

ticket_regex.title: Ticket key regex
ticket_regex.description: Extended regex (grep -E) a ticket key must match in branch names and commit messages, e.g. PROJ-[0-9]+ (\d is accepted and read as [0-9]). Used by the Bash guard, the session banner and the skills. Set to `none` for repos without ticket keys.

default_branch.title: Default branch
default_branch.description: The branch work is diffed against and may never be pushed to directly. Leave empty to detect it from origin/HEAD (falls back to main).

protected_branches.title: Protected branches
protected_branches.description: Pipe-separated branch names or shell globs (e.g. main|release/*) the Bash guard refuses to push to, delete or force-push; the default branch is always included.

typecheck_script.title: Typecheck script name
typecheck_script.description: package.json script run per touched package by the Stop gate, with the package manager the repo uses (lockfile, then the packageManager field). Set to `none` to disable the typecheck gate.

typecheck_fallback.title: Whole-repo typecheck fallback
typecheck_fallback.description: Command run when no touched package has the script, e.g. pnpm exec tsc -b. Prefer incremental. Empty = no fallback.

typecheck_budget_s.title: Typecheck budget (seconds)
typecheck_budget_s.description: Past this the Stop gate asks Claude once to run the typecheck scoped, then skips that package for the rest of the branch. Non-numeric values fall back to 150. All Stop checks together stop at 270 s so they finish inside the hook's 300 s timeout.

py_lint_cmd.title: Python lint command
py_lint_cmd.description: Run by the Stop gate when Python files matching the Python path regex changed. {files} is replaced by those changed files (or `.` when the list is very long), so lint errors elsewhere in the repo do not block; keep `--force-exclude` so ruff still honours its excludes; a command without {files} runs as written (e.g. ruff check services/agent-service). Skipped with a one-time warning when the tool is not installed. Set to `none` to disable.

py_dir_regex.title: Python path regex
py_dir_regex.description: Changed Python files matching this regex trigger the Python lint (any Python file by default); use a directory prefix such as ^services/agent-service/ to scope it.

local_checks.title: Local checks (display)
local_checks.description: One line listing the repo's check commands, shown in the session banner and used by pr-self-review so Claude never guesses them.

eslint_fix_on_edit.title: Run eslint --fix on each edit
eslint_fix_on_edit.description: 1 (or true) runs eslint --fix on the edited TS/JS file; 0 (or false) skips it (type-aware eslint configs can take seconds per file).

demo_branch.title: Demo / POC branch
demo_branch.description: Name of the long-lived demo branch (pushed to a shared remote; merge-only). Used by the poc and port skills, by commit-push-pr to refuse opening PRs from it, and by the Bash guard to block rebases on it. Leave empty if none.

demo_marker.title: Demo-only marker
demo_marker.description: Comment marker for shortcuts that must never reach the default branch, written as MARKER(<feature>): <why>. pr-self-review and commit-push-pr fail a production diff containing it; port drops such hunks.
